MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The twelve-inch caliper fits my fabrication work and offers a concrete capability beyond my existing six-inch caliper: measuring larger parts.",
    "The infrared thermometer relates to my repair and inspection work, so its purpose fits even though I would skip this particular item as a duplicate."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "My screws, rivets, drill bits and grommet press support fastening and working with physical materials; they do not establish that I own a 3D printer or need filament.",
    "Different filament colors, shiny finishes and a bulk pack do not solve an identified problem in my current projects.",
    "The recommended thermometer adds no clear capability beyond the one I recently bought, which has a wider stated temperature range."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in workshop tools seems to have been stretched into an assumed interest in 3D printing supplies.",
    "The repeated filament suggestions treat variations in color and material as relevant choices before establishing that I need filament at all."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases repeatedly involve fastening, joining, cutting and measuring; supplies that support those tasks have a clearer connection to what I am doing.",
    "Tools I already bought matter: a larger caliper expands what I can measure, while another thermometer largely repeats a capability I already have.",
    "Printer consumables require a specific printing need and compatible equipment, neither of which is established by my history."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly recognize my fabrication and measurement needs but wrongly extend them into a need for 3D printer supplies."
}
